calls.video_title: Forget the NVIDIA Dip (3 Stocks That Are Actually Cheap)
calls.price_at_call: $76 (stated current); comp-implied ~$118 if sold (he does not expect $118)
calls.thesis: Beaten-up ingredient/additives company (food, beauty, life sciences) at 18x 2027 earnings with earnings expected +28% in FY2027 (ends Sep 2027) and +32% over the next 2 years — PEG at or below 1, so a bargain. Activist investors have added two board members and the board is considering strategic alternatives (sale or spin-off).
calls.base_case: Turnaround proves out in 2027 reporting and valuation re-rates from 18x as earnings grow.
calls.bull_case: Sale/spin-off at a comp multiple (Celanese materials business sold at 13x EBITDA) implies ~$118/share vs $76 now, though he does not expect the full premium.
calls.bear_case: 11% of float sold short — shorts are usually informed; company has struggled for years and has not yet proven the turnaround; transition/sale execution risk.
